item.title: Hello 1.0.5
item.description:
Hello 1.0.5

  • Dictionary: add names and terms once and Hello hears them, spells them your way and fixes close misses. Say what a word is often heard as and that is corrected too.
  • Snippets: mark a dictionary entry as a snippet and saying its phrase pastes the saved text.
  • Add to Dictionary from any dictation in History.
  • Bangla punctuation: a full stop after Bangla becomes "।". Choose how numbers are written in Bangla sentences (as spoken, ১২৩ or 123).
  • Paste check: if an app ignores the paste, your dictation stays on the clipboard and Hello tells you to press ⌘V.
  • Hello says when a password field or secure keyboard entry is stopping its shortcut.
  • Modifier keys that macOS still thinks are held are released after each dictation.
  • The app icon is refreshed in Finder and the Dock after an update.
  • Dictionary is ⌘7; Notetaker and History are now ⌘8 and ⌘9.
